title: Cross-Pollination Protocol v1 — Knowledge Signal + Demand Signal Standard
l2_insight: Async knowledge sharing between agents requires three file-system primitives: knowledge signals (KSIG), demand signals (DEM), and cross-references (XREF)
summary: Formalized the Cross-Pollination Protocol for asynchronous agent-to-agent knowledge sharing. Built on Link P9 Runtime (384 lines) with two new ZONEID constants (0x1d4a18, 0x1d4a19), a JSON schema for knowledge signals, a lifecycle state machine for demand signals (OPEN→ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→FULFILLED→CLOSED), a file-system based discovery flow, and a cross-reference tracking format. Added `omega check-feed`, `omega consume`, `omega demand-status`, and `omega demand-claim` CLI commands.
key_insights: Three protocol layers: signals (what's known), demands (what's needed), cross-refs (who learned what)
ZONEID_KNOWLEDGE=0x1d4a18 and ZONEID_DEMAND=0x1d4a19 added to cvar_table with validate_zoneid support
check-feed CLI command scans knowledge_feed/ and demand_signals/ for unconsumed content
Cross-references at knowledge/cross_references/<consumer>/ track provenance of every insight transfer
Lilith's LILY_PAD design had 6 demand signals and 1 KSIG — this protocol makes them machine-readable
